title: Tum Haseen Main Jawan
desc: A navy officer who has had a number of affairs with attractive young women meets a beautiful girl and falls in love. Though she loves him in return, another admirer of hers tells the officer that she is deceiving him and is the mother of a child.

title: Budkaar
desc: Mini, a young woman, is kidnapped from a pub and police investigate the case. However, when her sister sets out to find her, she uncovers a criminal nexus which shakes the city.

title: Insaf Ka Tarazu
desc: Ramesh, a multi-millionaire, falls madly in love with Bharti. In the turnout of events, Bharti kills Ramesh. Watch the heart wrenching drama to know what compels her to take this dire step.

title: Tawaif
desc: Due to unforeseen circumstances, Dawood accepts Sultana, a courtesan, as his wife in spite of being in love with author Kaynat. His life soon changes when he finds himself falling for Sultana.
